statusText: Mapped policy state: green / EA_ON. NQ is closed for the weekend, so no persistent one-way price path is currently observable.
recommendation: Tail remains below the watch threshold; fresh Saudi security alerts and energy-supply disruption keep reopening risk elevated without live NQ confirmation.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress as fresh Saudi alerts raise weekend gap risk
body: Friday ended with the Nasdaq up 0.40% on semiconductor strength despite negative breadth, while the U.S. 10-year yield was around 5% and crude remained above $100. Fresh air-raid alerts in Riyadh and ongoing Saudi crude-supply disruption increase weekend gap uncertainty, but NQ is closed and no persistent mean-reversion failure can be observed.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail moved from WATCH during Friday's stressed trading into the low band after the close as two-way structure returned and live price discovery ended. Stress stayed high to extreme into Saturday as oil, yields and Middle East risks remained elevated.
outlookSummary: NQ remains closed throughout this 24-hour forecast horizon. Tail stays low because no live one-way structure can be observed, while extreme-to-high Stress persists from energy supply risk, elevated yields and Middle East security developments. The next decisive path checkpoint is Sunday's futures reopening.
